blog.hero_title: Nature's most complete superfood — pressed into a tiny green tablet.

Astronauts later took it to space. Today, the World Health Organization has called it 'the best food for tomorrow.' DXN bottles 500 of those tiny green tablets so you can put it to work in your own life — starting tomorrow morning.
blog.benefits_title: Why this isn't just another supplement
blog.benefits_intro: Spirulina is one of the only foods on earth that delivers complete protein, essential vitamins, rare minerals and powerful antioxidants in the same bite. Most multivitamins are synthetic chemistry. This is whole, living food.

benefits.title: 60%+ Complete Plant Protein
benefits.body: Gram-for-gram more protein than beef, and it carries all 9 essential amino acids your body cannot make on its own. Ideal for vegetarians, athletes and anyone trying to eat less meat without losing strength.

benefits.title: Natural, Sustained Energy
benefits.body: Iron, B-vitamins (including B12) and GLA fatty acids fuel your cells from the inside, instead of spiking and crashing your blood sugar like caffeine and sugary energy drinks do.

benefits.title: Phycocyanin Antioxidants
benefits.body: The blue pigment unique to spirulina is one of the most potent antioxidants ever measured — it neutralizes the free radicals behind premature aging, low immunity and chronic fatigue.

benefits.title: Heart, Skin & Detox Support
benefits.body: Studies show daily spirulina helps balance cholesterol, supports liver detox, calms inflammation and brightens skin from the inside — a beauty supplement disguised as a green tablet.

blog.feelings_title: What you'll start to feel within weeks
blog.feelings_intro: Customers tell us the same thing again and again: the changes are subtle for the first 7–10 days, then they hit all at once. Here's what to look out for.

feelings.title: Steady, all-day energy — no 3 PM crash
feelings.body: Spirulina feeds your mitochondria, the tiny power plants in every cell. Most people notice they stop reaching for that second or third coffee within two weeks.

feelings.title: Fewer colds, faster recovery
feelings.body: Phycocyanin and beta-carotene support your immune cells. You'll bounce back from late nights, long flights and seasonal bugs much faster.

feelings.title: Better workouts, less soreness
feelings.body: Complete amino acids and iron help your muscles rebuild after training, while antioxidants reduce next-day soreness. A favorite of UAE-based runners and CrossFitters.

feelings.title: Clearer skin, healthier hair
feelings.body: Chlorophyll detoxifies, B-vitamins support hair and nails, and antioxidants give your skin a natural glow. Many women notice the difference before their partner does.

feelings.title: Sharper focus, calmer mind
feelings.body: Stable B12 and GLA levels are linked to better mood and concentration. Spirulina is one of the very few plant foods that delivers both.

blog.cultivation_title: Grown under tropical sun. Never touched by chemicals.
cultivation_body: Most cheap spirulina on the market is grown in dusty open ponds with whatever water is nearby. We don't do that. DXN cultivates its spirulina in long, shallow, mineral-rich freshwater ponds under direct equatorial sunlight — the exact conditions this algae has thrived in for over 3.5 billion years.

Once it reaches peak nutrient density, it's harvested, gently washed and spray-dried at low temperature to lock in every vitamin, enzyme and antioxidant. Then it's pressed — under high pressure, with zero added binders or fillers — into a 500 mg tablet that holds its shape and dissolves cleanly in your stomach.
From pond to tablet, no chemicals, no irradiation, no animal products, and absolutely no shortcuts. The result is one of the cleanest spirulinas you can put on a UAE shelf.
blog.purity_intro: Read the back of most supplement bottles and you'll see a list of ingredients you can't pronounce. Read ours, and you'll see one word.
blog.usage_intro: Spirulina is a food, not a drug — there's no rigid timing. But here's how most of our customers get the best results.

usage_steps.title: Start with 3 tablets
usage_steps.body: For the first 3 days, take 3 tablets in the morning with a glass of water. This lets your body gently adjust to the rich nutrient load.

usage_steps.title: Build up to 6 daily
usage_steps.body: From day 4 onward, take 6 tablets daily — 3 with breakfast and 3 with lunch, or all 6 at once before a workout. Avoid late evenings; the natural energy can keep you up.

usage_steps.title: Stay consistent
usage_steps.body: Real results show after 21–30 days of daily use. One bottle of 500 tablets gives you almost 3 full months — more than enough to feel the full transformation.

blog.testimonial_quote: I've tried every vitamin under the sun. Two weeks of DXN Spirulina and I stopped needing my second coffee, my skin cleared up, and I'm sleeping better than I have in years. The 500-tablet bottle is honestly the deal of the century.
blog.closing_title: Give your body 30 days. It'll do the rest.
blog.closing_body: With 500 tablets per bottle, free delivery on 2 or more, and secure cash-on-delivery across the UAE, there is genuinely no reason to wait. Add it to your cart, take it daily for one month, and let your energy, skin and immunity speak for themselves.
